name: wow-addon-dev
description: World of Warcraft addon workspace for Claude Code. /wow-addon-dev:init finds the addons already in a folder and declares them in addons.json with the client each one targets (read from the .toc). /wow-addon-dev:check runs the checks before a commit: Lua 5.1 syntax as the game parses it (with Elune), .toc files, file and function size, missing translations, and headless tests. /wow-addon-dev:new-addon creates an addon that passes them from the start. The workspace skill explains the layout, the checks, and how to check a Blizzard API against the targeted client's UI source instead of from memory.
